data.narrative:
Fortem Technologies is a Series C-stage defense and security company that has raised over $100M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 13 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage companies, supplemented by two public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private peers including Quantum-Systems, Helsing, Anduril Industries, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $100M total raised as a baseline proxy and applying a 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $170M. Peer-median analysis across the 13-company comparable set yields a median valuation of $2.1B, with a range spanning $300M to $18.0B. The peer cohort includes Quantum-Systems at $8.0B (Series C), Helsing at $18.0B (Series D), and Saronic at $9.2B (Series D), reflecting substantial dispersion within the defense tech segment.

The two methods triangulate to a range of $144M (low) to $2.5B (high), with a median of $1.2B. The gap between stage-progression and peer-median reflects material uncertainty about whether Fortem's profile aligns with lower-capitalized or higher-performing peers in the cohort. Key sensitivities include relative technology maturity, customer concentration risk, and revenue traction relative to the peer set. A narrowed range would require clarity on Fortem's current annual revenue and customer concentration metrics.
